inputs.name: columns
inputs.description: Columns to show, either field names (`["name", "email"]`) or column objects (`[{ field: "name", label: "Full Name", width: 200 }]`). The canonical spelling — the deprecated `fields` is only read when this is absent.

inputs.name: filter
inputs.description: Filter criteria in JSON-rules form. The canonical spelling — the deprecated `defaultFilters` is only read when this is absent.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Grid label, used as the table caption and as the export file title. The canonical spelling — the deprecated `title` is only read when this is absent.

inputs.name: sort
inputs.description: Initial sort order, `[{ field, order }]`. The canonical spelling — the deprecated single-sort `defaultSort` is only read when this is absent.

inputs.name: pagination
inputs.description: Pagination config, `{ pageSize, pageSizeOptions, … }`. Its presence is what enables paging; prefer it over the deprecated flat `pageSize` / `showPagination` pair.

inputs.name: searchableFields
inputs.description: Fields the toolbar search box queries. A non-empty list is what enables search — prefer it over the deprecated boolean `showSearch`, which cannot say WHICH fields to search.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: Data source configuration — a `ViewData` object discriminated by `provider`: `{ provider: "object", object }` (what an omitted `data` falls back to, using `objectName`), `{ provider: "api", read, write }`, `{ provider: "value", items: [...] }` for inline rows that bypass the object query, or `{ provider: "schema", schemaId }`. The canonical spelling — the deprecated `staticData` is the array-only shortcut for the `value` provider, so inline rows go under `items` here rather than in a bare array.

inputs.name: rowHeight
inputs.description: Row density. An unrecognised value falls back to `compact` rather than erroring.

inputs.name: frozenColumns
inputs.description: How many leading columns stay pinned while the grid scrolls horizontally.

inputs.name: resizable
inputs.description: Let users drag column borders to resize. The canonical spelling — the deprecated `resizableColumns` is only read when this is absent.

inputs.name: reorderableColumns
inputs.description: Let users drag columns into a different order.

inputs.name: showColumnTypeIcons
inputs.description: Show a field-type icon in each column header. Off by default — the type is usually obvious from the cell content, and the icons compete with the column labels.

inputs.name: rowColor
inputs.description: Rules that colour whole rows from a field value.

inputs.name: conditionalFormatting
inputs.description: Row/cell styling rules. Accepts both the ObjectUI `{ field, operator, value }` form and the spec expression form `{ condition, style }`.

inputs.name: grouping
inputs.description: Group rows by one or more fields into collapsible sections.

inputs.name: aggregations
inputs.description: Per-group roll-ups shown in group headers, `[{ field, type: "sum" | "count" | "avg" | "min" | "max" | "count_distinct" }]`. Needs `grouping` to have anything to roll up.

inputs.name: selection
inputs.description: Selection config, `{ type: "none" | "single" | "multiple" }`. The canonical spelling — the deprecated boolean/string `selectable` is only read when this is absent.

inputs.name: rowActions
inputs.description: Names of actions offered on each row’s menu.

inputs.name: bulkActions
inputs.description: Names of actions offered once rows are selected. Needs a multi-row `selection` to be reachable.

inputs.name: batchActions
inputs.description: Legacy alias of `bulkActions`, and the one the renderer reads FIRST when both are set. Prefer `bulkActions` in new schemas.

inputs.name: bulkActionDefs
inputs.description: Full inline bulk-action definitions, for actions that are not named entries in the object’s action set. Use `bulkActions` when the action already exists.

inputs.name: editable
inputs.description: Enable inline cell editing (double-click or Enter opens a cell).

inputs.name: singleClickEdit
inputs.description: With `editable`, a single click opens the cell instead of a double-click. Has no effect on a non-editable grid.

inputs.name: navigation
inputs.description: What a row click does, `{ mode: "page" | "drawer" | "modal" | "split" | "none", … }`.

inputs.name: operations
inputs.description: Toggles for the built-in create/read/update/delete/export/import affordances, e.g. `{ delete: false }`.

inputs.name: exportOptions
inputs.description: Export config, `{ formats, maxRecords, includeHeaders, fileNamePrefix }`. Needs `operations.export` to be reachable from the toolbar.

inputs.name: modalCloseButton
inputs.description: Show the modal presentation’s close button. Read at ObjectForm.tsx:361 and honoured by ModalForm.

inputs.name: contentLayout
inputs.description: How the modal presentation lays out sections. `tabbed` needs more than one section to differ from `simple` (ModalForm.tsx:638).

inputs.name: confirmOnDiscard
inputs.description: Ask before discarding unsaved edits when a drawer/modal form is dismissed. Set `false` to close immediately.

inputs.name: recordId
inputs.description: The record to load in `edit` / `view` mode. Leave unset for `create`.

inputs.name: customFields
inputs.description: Field definitions merged over the set generated from object metadata. With inline definitions and no data source, this becomes the only field source.

inputs.name: initialValues
inputs.description: Values to prefill in `create` mode.

inputs.name: initialData
inputs.description: Alternate spelling of `initialValues` that the drawer/modal presentations read FIRST (`schema.initialData || schema.initialValues`). Prefer `initialValues` in new schemas.

inputs.name: readOnly
inputs.description: Render every field read-only, whatever `mode` says.

inputs.name: nextText
inputs.description: Label of the next-step button (wizard).

inputs.name: prevText
inputs.description: Label of the previous-step button (wizard).

inputs.name: submitBehavior
inputs.description: Declarative post-submit behaviour, one of `{ kind: "thank-you", title?, message? }`, `{ kind: "redirect", url, delayMs? }`, `{ kind: "continue" }`, `{ kind: "next-record" }`. When present it takes precedence over `successMessage` / `navigateOnSuccess` / `resetOnSuccess`.

inputs.name: successMessage
inputs.description: Toast shown after a successful submit. Ignored when `submitBehavior` or `navigateOnSuccess` is set.

inputs.name: navigateOnSuccess
inputs.description: Path to navigate to after a successful create/update. Supports `{id}` / `{recordId}` interpolation from the saved record and is same-origin-guarded. Takes precedence over `successMessage`.

inputs.name: resetOnSuccess
inputs.description: Clear the form after a successful submit instead of keeping the saved values.

inputs.name: mobile
inputs.description: Phone-only presentation overrides, e.g. `{ stepper: "auto", stepperMinFields: 8, fullscreenLongText: true }`.

inputs.name: recordId
inputs.description: The parent record to load in `edit` mode. Leave unset for `create`.

inputs.name: formType
inputs.description: How the PARENT half of the form is presented. The detail grids below it are unaffected.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.description: Which parent fields to show, in order. Ignored when `sections` is given — sections carry their own field lists.

inputs.name: submitText
inputs.description: Label of the button that saves the parent and every detail row in one batch.

inputs.name: initialValues
inputs.description: Values to prefill on the PARENT record in `create` mode.

inputs.name: initialData
inputs.description: Alternate spelling of `initialValues` the renderer also reads (MasterDetailForm.tsx:602). Prefer `initialValues` in new schemas.

inputs.name: taxRateField
inputs.description: Name of the field ON THE CHILD object that holds each line’s tax rate. Feeds the line-items totals row; leave unset when the detail rows carry no tax.

inputs.name: calendar
inputs.description: startDateField, endDateField, titleField, colorField

inputs.name: gantt
inputs.description: startDateField, endDateField, titleField, progressField, percentageField, colorField, dependenciesField

inputs.name: map
inputs.description: latitudeField, longitudeField, titleField

inputs.name: aggregate
inputs.description: Aggregation config: { field, function, groupBy }

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Helper text rendered under the value.

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: Heading of the drill-down panel. Defaults to `label` — set it only when the records list wants a different name from the tile.

inputs.name: filter
inputs.description: Criteria the aggregation is scoped by. The same filter narrows the drill-down list, so the number and the records behind it always agree.

inputs.name: colorVariant
inputs.description: Colour of the icon container. Semantic, not decorative: `success` / `warning` / `danger` should track what the number means.

inputs.name: variant
inputs.description: `card` draws the tile’s own surface; `bare` drops it, for a metric already sitting inside a card.

inputs.name: format
inputs.description: Numeral-style format pattern, e.g. `0,0`, `$0,0`, `0%`. Use `currency` instead of hard-coding a currency symbol here.

inputs.name: currency
inputs.description: ISO 4217 code, e.g. `USD`. Enables locale-aware currency formatting of the value.

inputs.name: prefix
inputs.description: Static text placed before the formatted value.

inputs.name: suffix
inputs.description: Static text placed after the formatted value.

inputs.name: invert
inputs.description: Display `1 - value` — for gauges whose good direction is down, such as error rate shown as uptime.

inputs.name: fallbackValue
inputs.description: Value shown when no data source resolves. For static/demo tiles; a bound metric should not need it.

inputs.name: trend
inputs.description: Static trend badge: `{ value, label, direction }`. Use `compareTo` instead when the trend should be computed from data.

inputs.name: compareTo
inputs.description: Period-over-period comparison, `{ kind: "previousPeriod" }` or `{ kind: "previousYear" }` — the computed alternative to a static `trend`.

inputs.name: drillDown
inputs.description: Click-through config that opens the records behind the number.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: Optional static data

inputs.name: aggregate
inputs.description: Aggregation config: { field, function, groupBy }

inputs.name: drillDown
inputs.description: Segment drill config: { enabled?, filter?, title?, target?: 'drawer' | 'dialog', columns?, maxRows? }. Present = on; {} is enough. Clicking a segment opens the underlying records filtered by the clicked category.

inputs.name: widgets
inputs.description: The widget tree — the spec’s DashboardWidget[]. Each widget binds a dataset (ADR-0021) and may carry a layout ({ x, y, w, h }) and filterBindings. When omitted the dashboard renders an empty grid.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Display name, shown as the header title when `header` is declared — a string or an inline per-locale map such as { en, "zh-CN" }. Spec-canonical spelling; the legacy `title` spelling is not authoring surface.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Header description shown under the title — a string or an inline per-locale map. Rendered only when `header` is declared and `header.showDescription` is not false.

inputs.name: header
inputs.description: Header block: { showTitle?, showDescription?, actions? }. Strict — the contract rejects any other key. Renders nothing (zero pixels) when everything it would show is suppressed.

inputs.name: globalFilters
inputs.description: Dashboard-level filter bar — the spec’s GlobalFilter[]. Filter values live as dashboard variables (readable in widget expressions as page.<name>) and are AND-merged into each bound widget’s query per its filterBindings.

inputs.name: dateRange
inputs.description: Built-in date-range filter: { field?, defaultRange?, allowCustomRange? }. `defaultRange` takes the spec’s date presets plus "custom"; the bound field defaults to created_at.

inputs.name: refreshInterval
inputs.description: Auto-refresh period in seconds. Zero or a negative value disables the timer, and it only runs when the host wires an onRefresh handler.

inputs.name: columns
inputs.description: Number of columns for field layout (1-4)

inputs.name: sections
inputs.description: Field groups rendered as the detail body, in order. Every entry is an OBJECT — `{ name?, label?, columns?, fields }` — a bare section-id string is NOT accepted (the spec retired that spelling in objectstack#5611, and the renderer reads name/label/fields off each entry, so a string entry renders no fields at all). `fields` (required) are the field names shown in this section, in order. `label` is the section heading; omit it for an untitled, borderless section. `name` is a stable snake_case identifier and the i18n anchor — the heading resolves through objects.<object>._sections.<name>.label, so a section without a name shows its authored label in every locale. `columns` (1-4) is THIS section's field-grid width; omit it and the renderer derives the width. Authoring `sections` at all makes it the only source of the detail body; omit it and the body falls back to the object's highlightFields.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.description: Explicit field list (overrides highlightFields)

inputs.name: hideFields
inputs.description: Field names to omit from the body — applied to the top-level `fields` list AND to every section's `fields`. Bare field names only. Authors rarely need it: the synth pipeline fills it with the fields already shown in `record:highlights`, and hand-authored pages get the same dedup live from HighlightFieldsContext, so its purpose is suppressing a field you do not want repeated (the page H1 title field is dropped for you too). Hiding every field of a section leaves that section out entirely.

inputs.name: inlineEdit
inputs.description: Offer the per-field double-click / pencil inline-edit affordances in the detail body. On by default, and an OPT-OUT only: the value is combined with the object's own editability (system, engine-owned, append-only and better-auth objects are not user-editable unless they opened userActions.edit) and with the server's effective API operation set for the object, so `false` always wins while `true` cannot open editing the platform refuses. The edit session and the atomic Save bar are hosted by the page, so one draft spans the highlights strip and this body.

inputs.name: showHeader
inputs.description: Render the detail body's own title / follow-star / copy-id chip above the fields. Off by default because this block is normally composed under a `page:header` that already draws that chrome, and turning it on there shows the record title twice. Set it true only when this block is the whole page.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.description: Key fields to highlight (1-7), bare names or {name,label?,icon?,type?,readonly?}. Set readonly: true on an entry to render that chip read-only — it suppresses the inline-edit affordance and the HeaderHighlight editability gate enforces it. Use it for hook/automation-maintained columns that must not be hand-edited from the record header; marking the OBJECT field readonly instead would also strip the hook's own write-back.

inputs.name: layout
inputs.description: Layout orientation for highlight fields

inputs.name: objectName
inputs.description: Related object name (e.g. "task")

inputs.name: relationshipField
inputs.description: Field on the related object pointing back to this record

inputs.name: relationshipValueField
inputs.description: Which field OF THIS PARENT record `relationshipField` stores. Defaults to "id"; set it to the field a name-keyed junction points at (e.g. "name" when sys_user_position.position holds sys_position.name). The resolved value drives three things at once — the list filter, the Add-picker link value, and the pre-filled create form — so they cannot drift apart. While the parent record is still loading, a non-"id" field resolves to null and the list holds its fetch rather than querying on an empty value.

inputs.name: columns
inputs.description: Fields to display in the related list

inputs.name: limit
inputs.description: Records to display initially

inputs.name: filter
inputs.description: Additional filter criteria, as spec `ViewFilterRule` entries (`[{ field, operator, value }]`). AND-combined with the parent relationship condition, never a replacement for it: it can only narrow this record's children. Also the key a per-element `dataSource` binding's composed filter lands on.

inputs.name: actions
inputs.description: Action IDs available for related records

inputs.name: add
inputs.description: Adds an "Add" button that assigns EXISTING records instead of creating one — the m2m/junction case. Shape: `{ picker: { object, valueField?, labelField?, filter? }, linkField?, label? }`. `picker.object` (required) is the object whose records the dialog offers. `picker.valueField` is the field of the picked record used as the link value (default "id"); `picker.labelField` is the column shown in the picker rows (default "name", and the other columns are derived from that object's schema). With `linkField` set, selecting records CREATES rows in this list's own object as `{ [relationshipField]: parentValue, [linkField]: pickedId }` — the junction case; omit `linkField` and the picked child is RE-PARENTED instead, by setting its own `relationshipField` to this parent. `label` is the button text (default "Add", localizable inline). Setting `add` also enables generic link removal on rows when no host delete handler is wired. `picker.filter` restricts which records the dialog offers — a list of `{ field, operator, value }` rules in the same vocabulary as this list's own `filter`, applied as a hard constraint the user cannot widen (it never appears as an editable filter row).

inputs.name: statusField
inputs.description: Field representing the current status/stage

inputs.name: stages
inputs.description: Explicit stage definitions [{ value, label }] (else derived from field metadata)

inputs.name: types
inputs.description: Allow-list of feed item types to show (comment, field_change, task, event, email, call, note, file, record_create, record_delete, approval, sharing, system). Omit for all; unrecognised entries are ignored.

inputs.name: filterMode
inputs.description: Filter the timeline dropdown starts on. The user can still change it; an unrecognised value falls back to "all".

inputs.name: showFilterToggle
inputs.description: Expose the activity-type filter dropdown in the panel header

inputs.name: limit
inputs.description: Items per page. Also caps the scoped sys_activity read; "Load more" grows the window by this much.

inputs.name: showCompleted
inputs.description: Include completed activities (sys_activity type "completed", which surfaces as a task item). Off by default.

inputs.name: unifiedTimeline
inputs.description: Mix field changes and comments in one timeline (Airtable style). Off keeps the panel a discussion stream — field changes stay in record:history.

inputs.name: showCommentInput
inputs.description: Show the composer. Requires a host discussion context to persist the comment (record detail pages provide one); without it the feed is read-only.

inputs.name: enableMentions
inputs.description: Offer @-mention autocomplete in the composer, from the host discussion context's user list. Off withholds the suggestions.

inputs.name: enableReactions
inputs.description: Show emoji reactions on feed items. Toggling one requires a host discussion context; without it existing reactions still render, read-only.

inputs.name: enableThreading
inputs.description: Group replies under their parent comment. Posting a reply requires a host discussion context.

inputs.name: showSubscriptionToggle
inputs.description: NOT IMPLEMENTED — no record-subscription backend exists yet, so this renders nothing whatever it is set to. Declared for spec parity only (objectui#3165).

inputs.name: position
inputs.description: Where the panel docks relative to the record body

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: Panel width as a CSS value (side positions only)

inputs.name: feed
inputs.description: Activity-feed config nested inside the panel — same shape as record:activity

inputs.name: limit
inputs.description: Maximum history entries to display

inputs.name: emptyText
inputs.description: Copy shown when the record has no history

inputs.name: unknownUserText
inputs.description: Copy substituted when an entry has no resolvable actor

inputs.name: actionNames
inputs.description: Action names to expose, in order — resolved from the actions declared on the object. With no names (and no host-supplied actions) nothing is looked up and the bar renders its empty placeholder

inputs.name: requiredPermissions
inputs.description: Hide the whole bar unless the user holds these permissions

inputs.name: location
inputs.description: Which declared action location this bar renders

inputs.name: inline
inputs.description: Render in the flow instead of folding into the record header

inputs.name: variant
inputs.description: Passed to the Button primitive; a per-action variant overrides it

inputs.name: size
inputs.description: Passed to the Button primitive; a per-action size overrides it

inputs.name: hideEmpty
inputs.description: Drop the rail entirely when no entries resolve

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: Accepts an inline translation map ({ en, "zh-CN", … })

inputs.name: body
inputs.description: Accepts an inline translation map ({ en, "zh-CN", … })

inputs.name: visible
inputs.description: Expression gating the banner against the current record

inputs.name: icon
inputs.description: Lucide icon name; defaults to the severity icon

inputs.name: action
inputs.description: { actionName, label?, variant? } — the action the banner offers

inputs.name: dismissKey
inputs.description: Stable key the dismissal is remembered under

inputs.name: items
inputs.description: Tab definitions [{ label, value?, icon?, count?, visibleWhen?, children }] — value is the stable ?tab= URL token, count auto-derives from record:related_list descendants when omitted

inputs.name: alwaysShowStrip
inputs.description: Keep the tab strip visible when only one tab survives. Default false: a lone pill is clutter rather than an affordance, so a one-tab strip is hidden and its panel renders bare. Count the tabs AFTER each item visibleWhen predicate has been evaluated — a page authored with four tabs of which three are conditional reaches this rule whenever the other three are false.

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: Accepts an inline translation map ({ en, "zh-CN", … })

inputs.name: children
inputs.description: Card content components, in order (the card body slot)

inputs.name: items
inputs.description: Panel definitions [{ label, icon?, collapsed?, children }] — collapsed: false opens a panel by default

inputs.name: children
inputs.description: Child components rendered inside this container, in order

inputs.name: children
inputs.description: Child components rendered inside this container, in order

inputs.name: children
inputs.description: Child components rendered inside this container, in order

inputs.name: content
inputs.description: Accepts an inline translation map ({ en, "zh-CN", … })

inputs.name: object
inputs.description: Object the aggregate runs over

inputs.name: field
inputs.description: Measure field (required for every aggregate except count)

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Accepts an inline translation map ({ en, "zh-CN", … })

inputs.name: action
inputs.description: Inline ActionDef executed on click (url / navigation / api / script / modal / flow); omitted → renders inert

inputs.name: icon
inputs.description: Lucide icon name

inputs.name: items
inputs.description: Term/description pairs [{ term, description }]

inputs.name: inline
inputs.description: Term and description on one baseline-aligned row

inputs.name: object
inputs.description: Object whose records the list repeats over

inputs.name: fields
inputs.description: Columns per row — bare names or { field, label? }

inputs.name: divided
inputs.description: Separator between rows

inputs.name: gap
inputs.description: Gap between items (0-8)

inputs.name: wrap
inputs.description: Allow flex items to wrap

inputs.name: columns
inputs.description: Number of columns on mobile devices

inputs.name: smColumns
inputs.description: Columns at sm breakpoint (>640px)

inputs.name: mdColumns
inputs.description: Columns at md breakpoint (>768px)

inputs.name: lgColumns
inputs.description: Columns at lg breakpoint (>1024px)

inputs.name: xlColumns
inputs.description: Columns at xl breakpoint (>1280px)

inputs.name: gap
inputs.description: Gap between items (0-12)

inputs.name: items
inputs.description: Array of { trigger, content, value }

inputs.name: padding
inputs.description: Padding value (0, 1-8, 10, 12, 16)

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: Supports {field} interpolation and inline translation maps; falls back to the record title

inputs.name: subtitle
inputs.description: Same interpolation as Title

inputs.name: actions
inputs.description: Action buttons rendered in the header, before any host-injected system actions

inputs.name: recordChrome
inputs.description: Set false for the bare h1 header on non-record pages

inputs.name: maxVisible
inputs.description: How many header actions render as inline buttons on desktop before the rest fold into the overflow menu. A positive integer — the contract rejects 0 and fractional values. Two kinds of action are routed to the overflow menu regardless of this budget and never occupy an inline slot: an action whose locations declare record_more without record_header, and any action with component action:menu.

inputs.name: mobileMaxVisible
inputs.description: The same inline-button budget on mobile viewports, where horizontal room is scarce. A positive integer, defaulting to 1; the desktop half is Max Inline Actions, and the overflow routing rules stated there apply unchanged.

inputs.name: html
inputs.description: Raw HTML content
